## Triage: first grade · `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T07:57Z

Read fresh. On an object with no `fieldGroups`, Studio's page-create seed (`anchors.ts:208`) and its slotted preview (`PagePreview.tsx:301`) call `buildDefaultPageSchema` without the detail sections the runtime passes (`RecordDetailView.tsx:3341`).
- A page created from the seed persists a bare `record:details`. Since PR #12441 that node draws `highlightFields`, and on an object with none of those it draws an empty body. The running app's default page draws the full sections.

**Grade p2:**
- Every Studio-created record page on such an object persists a body that differs from the runtime's. The dev's rough census is about 31 of 111 objects with no `highlightFields`; the `fieldGroups` count is not measured.
- It is not the consumer rule's p1 shape:
  - Studio writes nothing the protocol refuses;
  - the renderer honours the declared fallback (that was #12433);
  - the author sees the same body in the preview, so the divergence is not silent.

**Lane `domain:ui`** (`packages/app-shell`, metadata-admin).

**Scope:** the card's ask.
- The seed and the preview take the runtime's sections from one shared derivation (⛔ not a second copy).
- Pin that seed, preview and runtime agree on an object with no `fieldGroups`. CONTROL: an object with `fieldGroups` is unchanged.
- Correct `resolveDetailSections`' "falls back to its flat layout" doc in the same PR.

`finding` leaves on grading.

Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` reads no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no (if the shared derivation must be exported from `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s entry, the dev measures it and the line is corrected to yes, at least `minor`)
Responsibility: `objectui's Studio page-create seed and slotted page preview, which call buildDefaultPageSchema without the runtime's detail sections | the runtime's own RecordDetailView already derives them; Studio does not reuse that derivation | every Studio author who creates or previews a record page for an object with no fieldGroups (about 31 of 111 objectstack objects have no highlightFields; the fieldGroups count is not measured)`
Thread-read: 6187347108
Serial constraints cleared: objectui#12427's PR #12443 edits `RecordDetailView.tsx`'s page-header overflow entry, not the `synthParts` derivation; whichever lands second merges `main` again (a merge, never a rebase). objectui#12459 (`studio-design/`, `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) does not touch `anchors.ts` or `previews/`. objectui#12440 and objectui#12429 (this seat, in flight) are disjoint.

## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12467 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-15T10:25Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `3a78d8b`, against triage's scope (`6187347108`) and the claim (`6187958892`), not against the dev's report.

- **Shape:** the PR is a draft against `main`. Its body opens `Fixes #12442`, the only closing keyword, followed by `Clause-②: no`. The governed sweep reads NOT governed, 692 lines (+554 / −138), 8 files.
- **One shared derivation, ⛔ not a second copy (triage's ruling), met:**
  - `RecordDetailView`'s section derivation (`toField`, the primary / "More details" split, the `fieldGroups` path, the audit and hidden-field filter, `isSecondaryField`) moves into the new internal module `views/recordDetailSections.ts` as `deriveRecordDetailSections`. The seat read it against the removed block: the logic is unchanged.
  - The runtime now calls it with the same heading it translated before (`sectionLabel(objectDef.name, 'details', t('detail.sectionMoreDetails', …))`), so the running app's page is unchanged.
  - The seed (`anchors.ts`) and the slotted preview (`PagePreview.tsx`) call `deriveStudioDetailSections`, which is the same call. It returns `undefined` when the object's `fieldGroups` apply, so a grouped object keeps today's `{ group }` references (the CONTROL).
  - Nothing is re-exported from a package entry, so `Clause-②: no` holds.
- **What the seed persists:** `toAuthoredDetailSections` reduces each field entry to its name, the only `fields` spelling `RecordDetailsProps.sections[].fields` declares. `record:details` re-reads each named field's label and type from the object definition.
- **The doc:** `resolveDetailSections`' "falls back to its flat layout" now says what a bare node draws since objectui#12433 (`highlightFields`, else an empty body).
- **Pins and ablation:** an agreement test (seed, preview and runtime carry the same sections for an object with no `fieldGroups`; a grouped object unchanged; the seeded page parses against the spec) plus preview tests. Reverting the preview call site fails 2. Reverting the seed call site fails 3. The one vacuously green case was hardened to assert the sections exist first. Restore was proven by blob hash.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell: patch` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail: patch` (doc only).
- **Evidence:** the closure build and both type-checks exit 0. The 12 targeted files give 75/75; that run was unlocked with `--maxWorkers=1` after 27 minutes of lock time-outs behind other seats' runs, declared as narrowed. The battery exits 0. The wider suite is declared to CI; its shards are read below.
- **Acceptance notes (not filed):**
  - The seed persists the "More details" heading as English text, because a seed has no translator. On a seeded page in a non-English locale with no per-object `_sections.details` translation, the heading reads in English where the default page shows the shell's translation. The section's `name: 'details'` keeps the per-object i18n anchor.
  - A grouped object's seed still writes the ungrouped bucket as one untitled section, while the runtime splits it into primary plus "More details". The CONTROL ruling keeps grouped objects unchanged, so this PR leaves it.
- **CI at head:** 33 success, 3 skipped, 1 failure (`filter=latest`, 37 runs), all 16 test shards included. The one red is the advisory `Spec Main Shape Gate`, and it is not this PR's:
  - It reports `TS2430` at `packages/types/src/layout.ts:1516` (`PageNodeSchema.kind` still names `'jsx'`, which objectstack-ai/objectstack#23638 retired). This PR does not touch that file, and `main`'s own run at 10:02Z is red with the same verdict. Filed as objectui#12468.
  - The workflow's header says the context is advisory on pull requests and does not subscribe to `merge_group`, so it is not in the queue's required set. This PR lands with it red on that basis; this comment is the record.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
